Record Class OffscreenButtons.Image

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.OffscreenButtons.Image
Record Components:
texture - texture resource, borrowed from Minecraft's resource manager
x - relative left edge in GUI pixels
y - relative top edge
width - positive displayed width
height - positive displayed height
u - source left UV
v - source top UV
uWidth - positive source UV width
vHeight - positive source UV height
tint - packed ARGB tint; white preserves the original image
Enclosing class:
OffscreenButtons
public static record OffscreenButtons.Image(net.minecraft.util.ResourceLocation texture, int x, int y, int width, int height, float u, float v, float uWidth, float vHeight, int tint) extends Record
A texture region drawn relative to the button's top-left corner. UV coordinates are normalized from zero to one.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal.
